$comment: Duplicate-code scope for scripts/check-duplicate-code.mjs. Generated code, fixtures, browser suites and declarations are excluded because their repetition is intentional or machine-produced. The broker and native Runner are standalone packages that cannot import the workspace observability runtime at run time; their dependency-free observability modules intentionally mirror the shared Sentry/analytics adapters and are reviewed as a pair. The Routines.production.tsx page is the flag-off surface kept beside Routines.tsx until the streamlined flag is removed; the two pages share the banner, bulk bar and empty states by design and are reviewed as a pair.
